context.summary: A pioneer river-haven and timber stockade founded on the western bank of the Silver Channel, guarding the primeval crossing into the Greenwood Vault.
context.host_region_lore: Tilled river-silt crofts and barley strips wrested from the ancient hemlocks of the Greenwood Vault, watered by the Silver Channel.
context.scale_profile: Small / Compact (Fledgling cluster. Small structural footprint with a high proportion of surrounding natural terrain, open yards, and frontier buffer.)

perimeters.lore: An unbroken canopy of moss-cloaked hemlocks and broad oaks, newly pierced along the Silver Channel by mortal woodcutters and the tilled crofts of Aethelford.
A majestic, half-league-wide river carrying mountain runoff through a fractured piedmont of rolling hills into the primeval basin.

perimeters.description: Transition into host region (Aethelford Crofts — Cleared_Land).
perimeters.lore: Tilled river-silt crofts and barley strips wrested from the ancient hemlocks of the Greenwood Vault, watered by the Silver Channel.

approaches.road_lore: A beaten dirt and crushed-limestone track hacked through the western fringes of the Greenwood Vault, linking Dun Kestrel to the river wharf at Aethelford.
approaches.destination_lore: A hill-clan redoubt perched atop the chalk bluffs of the Undulating Downs, encircled by timber palisades and pastoral sheep-runs.

context.world_relations: Aethelford channels harvested hemlock timber up the Downs-Way to Dun Kestrel in exchange for pastoral wool, mutton, and chalk, while shipping surplus river-silt barley down the Silver Channel.
context.architectural_rationale: The timber palisade guards the northern perimeter against primeval forest hazards, while the central thoroughfare connects the Downs-Way directly to the timber sawmill, barley granary, and southern river wharf.

0.name: Frontier Buffer & Wilderness
0.lore: The dense hemlock canopy of the Greenwood Vault to the north and the wide, churning currents of the Silver Channel to the south and east.

1.name: Stockade Enclosure & Yard
1.lore: A compact timber-walled haven housing pioneer lodgings, a central hearth fire, and timber processing yards.

2.name: Silver Channel Wharf
2.lore: A heavy oak river landing and timber pier where rafts, barges, and ferries dock along the Silver Channel.

3.name: Downs-Way Trailhead
3.lore: The north gate approach where crushed limestone from the Undulating Downs meets Aethelford's palisade.

4.name: Silver-Silt Crofts
4.lore: Fertile riverbank barley strips and tilled soil wrested from the forest edge.

north_gate.name: Downs-Way Gatehouse
north_gate.lore: A stout double-timber gate guarding the northern entry into Aethelford along the Downs-Way road from Dun Kestrel.

pioneer_hearth.name: Aethelford Pioneer Lodge
pioneer_hearth.lore: A massive flagstone hearth and log hall serving as the settlement's meeting place, shelter, and central warmth.

sawmill.name: Greenwood Sawmill & Yard
sawmill.lore: A water-assisted pit saw mill that processes hemlock and oak timber felled in the Greenwood Vault for export and construction.

granary.name: Barley Granary & Store
granary.lore: A stilted timber storehouse holding dried river-silt barley and preserved winter rations harvested from local crofts.

river_wharf.name: Silver Channel Wharf
river_wharf.lore: A reinforced log wharf and boardwalk facilitating river transport and trade with downriver settlements.
